in_sanskrit.name: Bikku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little monk
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bikku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bikku', meaning a little monk or a young monk in training. In Hindu mythology, 'Bikku' represents devotion, self-discipline, and spiritual growth.

in_tamil.name: Bikku

In Hindu mythology, 'Bikku' represents devotion, self-discipline, and spiritual growth.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Bikku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bikku', meaning a little monk or a young monk in training. In Hindu mythology, 'Bikku' represents devotion, self-discipline, and spiritual growth.
